reason: It's free and the coupon-with-PIN thing is exactly what I never had when I paid that creator: I'd finally see real walk-ins, not likes. I'll get my nephew to list us, but I'm not paying anyone or bringing creators until I see it work.
objection: Will good creators actually be on it? A small beta team in Bengaluru could mean a handful of wannabes chasing free collabs, and my staff won't bother with PINs if nobody walks in with a coupon.
would_change_my_mind: If after a month no decent creator near me shows interest, or the coupons bring zero customers, I'd drop it.
